name: Shanghai Ace Investment & Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Ace Investment & Development Co., Ltd., established in 2003 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, operates as a subsidiary of Jiangsu Yashi Investment Group Co., Ltd. This company specializes in comprehensive supply chain management across China, focusing on both logistics services and supply chain execution trading. Its extensive offerings include multimodal transportation via rail, road, and waterways, as well as third-party logistics (3PL) solutions. The firm also provides bonded warehousing, manages loading and unloading operations, and offers supervision for warehousing and logistics activities. Furthermore, it actively engages in the logistics and trade of various commodities, such as sulfur, fertilizers, non-ferrous metals, mineral products, and other general goods.
